offset_convention: 0-based, end-exclusive Unicode character offsets into input_text

source_alignment_verification.verification_method: Main-agent re-sliced every gate quote and both child quotes against the matched corpus input_text; all source_text[start:end] values exactly matched quote.

gate_evidence.quote: The error may be caused by the basic system or a technology function (e.g. FBLOCKS, DCC, TEC).

evidence.quote: a technology function (e.g. FBLOCKS, DCC, TEC)

review_candidates.review_reason: Cause sentence explicitly states that the error may be caused by either of two alternatives.

gate_evidence.quote: Defective or missing files were detected on the memory card when booting.

review_candidates.review_reason: One detection statement names two alternative file states.

gate_evidence.quote: It is possible that the backup was interrupted by switching off or withdrawing the memory card.

children.text: withdrawing the memory card interrupted the backup

review_candidates.review_reason: The cause sentence explicitly connects two actions as alternatives that may interrupt the same backup.

gate_evidence.quote: Safety-relevant parameters have been changed or a fault is present.

review_candidates.review_reason: The Cause passage explicitly uses 'or'; the broad second branch needs reviewer confirmation as an independent child event.

gate_evidence.quote:
As a result of this fault, after the time parameterized in p9556 has expired, or the speed threshold parameterized in p9560
has been fallen below, message F01700 "STO initiated" is output.

evidence.quote: the time parameterized in p9556 has expired

children.text: speed threshold parameterized in p9560 fallen below

evidence.quote:
the speed threshold parameterized in p9560
has been fallen below

review_candidates.review_reason: The alternative triggers lead to associated message F01700, not to an F01701 top-level gate; target identity is explicit to prevent misattribution.

gate_evidence.quote:
The global control telegram to synchronize the clock cycles has failed - in cyclic operation - for several DP clock cycles or
has violated the time grid specified in the parameterizing telegram over several consecutive DP clock cycles (refer to the
bus cycle time, Tdp and Tpllw).

children.text: synchronization telegram failed over several cycles

evidence.quote: has failed - in cyclic operation - for several DP clock cycles

children.text: synchronization telegram violated specified time grid

evidence.quote: has violated the time grid specified in the parameterizing telegram over several consecutive DP clock cycles

review_candidates.review_reason: The same synchronization telegram is described as either of two alternative failure states.

gate_evidence.quote: An error was identified when executing the "Test signal" function (p5307.1 = 1) or auto tuning was selected (p5300 = 1).

review_candidates.review_reason: The error statement directly ties two operating conditions to the same record; later remedy wording is excluded.

gate_evidence.quote: The maximum permissible speed was either positively or negatively exceeded (p1082).

review_candidates.review_reason: Two directions modify the same exceeded-speed predicate; the scope is direction alternatives, not two independent root causes.

gate_evidence.quote: When selecting the brake test or starting the brake test, the brake was not open.

children.text: brake not open when selecting the brake test
brake not open when starting the brake test

review_candidates.review_reason: Either operation stage is stated as a context in which the same brake-not-open message occurs.

gate_evidence.quote: The maximum operating time of at least one fan will soon be reached, or has already been exceeded.

children.text: maximum fan operating time nearly reached

review_candidates.review_reason: The same threshold state is described as nearly reached or already exceeded; treat as one event-state scope.

gate_evidence.quote: fault in the motor or in the power cables.

review_candidates.review_reason: The OR is local to one compound cause phrase and does not label the entire cause list.

gate_evidence.quote: short-circuit in the motor cable or ground fault.

review_candidates.review_reason: One cause phrase explicitly states two alternatives.

gate_evidence.quote: motor has a short-circuit or fault to ground (frame).

review_candidates.review_reason: One compound cause item contains an explicit OR; other cause items remain outside this local gate.

gate_evidence.quote: The DC link has either a ground fault or a short-circuit.

review_candidates.review_reason: Either fault type is an alternative inside one explicitly numbered cause item; not a gate for the complete event cause set.

gate_evidence.quote:
One cause can be, e.g. that a DRIVE-CLiQ cable or
DRIVE-CLiQ component has been replaced.

review_candidates.review_reason: The manual explicitly presents one example cause with alternative replaced-object types; this does not close the full cause set.

gate_evidence.quote: The temperature monitoring of the internal braking resistor or the line reactor has responded.

children.text: temperature monitoring of internal braking resistor responded
temperature monitoring of line reactor responded

review_candidates.review_reason: The alternatives describe the source whose temperature monitoring responded, not necessarily independent root causes.

gate_evidence.quote: An inadmissibly high temperature was detected in the encoder electronics or the encoder evaluation.

children.text: high temperature detected in encoder electronics
high temperature detected in encoder evaluation

review_candidates.review_reason: The OR describes detection locations; this does not establish an independently confirmed physical root cause.

ambiguous_observations.reason: Comma-separated software support/compatibility phrases before 'or' make the first branch boundary uncertain; do not assume three OR children.
ambiguous_observations.quote:
The software for monitoring channel 2 does not support safe motion monitoring, is not compatible to the software for
monitoring channel 1 - or there is a communications error between the two monitoring channels.

ambiguous_observations.reason: Source says and/or, so a single AND or OR label is not justified.
ambiguous_observations.quote:
The existing Sensor Module software and/or hardware does not support the safe motion monitoring function with the higher-
level control.
